update.title: System Settings
update.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP · max 5 MB

mail.title: Email
mail.description: Server the center sends login codes and invitations with.

source.env: Using the environment variables (EMAIL_SERVER and EMAIL_FROM)
source.none: Not configured: the center cannot send emails

mailers.log: Log (writes emails to the server log, sends nothing)

mail.saveError: The email settings could not be saved
mail.resetConfirm: The saved settings are deleted and the center goes back to EMAIL_SERVER and EMAIL_FROM.
mail.resetSuccess: The environment variables are used now

test.title: Send a test email
test.description: Uses the saved settings. Save your changes first.

access.title: Security and access
access.description: Who can have an account and how they sign in, in the center and in the connected systems.

signupModes.invitation: By invitation only (or created by an admin)
signupModes.open: Open: anyone can create an account

access.allowedDomainsHelper: One per line or comma separated. Empty: any domain. Applies to new accounts and invitations; existing accounts do not change.
access.invalidDomains: There is an invalid domain (valid example: company.com)
access.twoFactorHelper: Whoever does not have it will set it up when signing in, also from the connected systems.
access.twoFactorAppliesToMe: You do not have it: after saving you will have to set it up to go on.
